tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250chad tho bsgrag pa ni/1$0000300 hūm̐/ sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa dang po la// 'og min gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis// chos kyi dbyings nas kī li'i sgra bsgrags tshe// rigs kyi khro bo lcam dral tshogs rnams kyis// so so'i sku mchog gsal bar bstan nas kyang*// ji ltar zhal bzhes dam las ma g.yel bar// mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// de 'og bar gyi bskal pa dbus ma la// mon kha ne ring seṅge rdzong gsum du// slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// jo mo mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis// lhag pa'i lha mchog dkyil 'khor bsgrubs pa'i tshe// dregs pa sde brgyad brtan ma gcu gnyis kyis// so so'i gzugs mchog gsal bar bstan nas kyang*// ji ltar zhal bzhes dam las ma g.yel bar// mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// de 'og bskal pa tha ma'i dus kyi tshe// rnga yab gling phran zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser// o rgyan chen po pad+ma thod phreng dang*// rig 'dzin chos dbang laṅka'i tshogs bcas kyis// rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe// phur srung bcu gnyis ging dang dam can gyis// so so'i gzugs mchog gsal bar bstan nas kyang*// ji ltar zhal bzhes dam las ma g.yel bar// mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// da lta sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag gis// mkha' 'gro dam can 'du ba'i gnas mchog 'dir// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas sku gsum 'grub pa dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis 'grub pa'i phyir// bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis// mchod gtor 'di zhes bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod//

ces pa 'di zhe chen rgyal tshab pad+ma rnam rgyal gsung du gsungs shing dil mkhyen rin po che'i thugs dam phur pod las byung ba'o// //dpe 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
